3. 3. 1. 5. 

5. Ruṇṇamidaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ gītaṃ. Ummattakamidaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ naccaṃ. Komārakamidaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ ativelaṃ dantavidaṃsakaṃ hasitaṃ.434

Tasmātiha bhikkhave setughāto gīte. Setughāto nacce. Alaṃ vo dhammapamoditānaṃ sataṃ sitaṃ sitamattāyāti.
